title: assign_thread silently swallows find_thread_by_message_ids error
description: email.rs:698: if let Ok(Some(...)) pattern silently discards Err(_) from find_thread_by_message_ids. A backend I/O error during thread lookup causes the email to be silently assigned to a brand-new thread instead of propagating the error. Reply emails get disconnected from their threads with no error returned to the client.
